text:
Maya CS: FYI Kairo's Content Ops reached out — they're planning to fold our summarization + synthetic QA into 4 more product teams next month. Concern: token spike and a renewal conversation in ~6w.

Emily (Kairo): +1. We're seeing embed+gen mix. Expected steady-state ~120 qps this month, peaky to 600 qps during ingest windows. Renewal depends on latency and cost predictability.

Maya CS: Noted. Proposal: dedicated pilot cluster (small reserved pool) + enablement workshop. Ravi, can you scope infra needs?

Ravi SE: Can do. Need: exact payload sizes, avg tokens per request, concurrency pattern. Also any sync vs async reqs. Can someone paste example payload?

Emily (Kairo): Example: `{"prompt":"summarize...","context_tokens":850}` avg output 120 tokens. Ingest windows 20-30min every 3 hours.

Ravi SE: OK — rough calc: 850+120 = ~1k tokens per call. At 600 qps that's ~600k tokens/sec peak. We'll need batching + prefix caching and suggest quantized 4-bit on smaller variants. I'll prep cost/latency estimates.

Alicia (Onboarding PM): I'll book an enablement session this week (30-45m) and an ops runbook review. Available Wed 10-11 or Thu 15-16 PT. Which works?

Jon (AE): Heads-up — renewal touchpoint scheduled in 6 weeks. If we can show pilot with SLA targets + a burst allocation, we reduce churn risk. Can we offer a 2-week burst capacity at no extra charge?

Ravi SE: I can spin up a small sandbox pod to validate throughput + KV prefix caches. @deploy-bot can you create a pod id for Kairo sandbox?

deploy-bot: pod created: `kairo-sandbox-34` — GPU pool: 2xA10G, autoscale disabled, metrics collection enabled.

Maya CS: :thumbsup: I'll loop in Support to capture feedback during pilot and create a renewal playbook. Also capture sample prompts for regression evals.

Emily (Kairo): Thanks, team. If we can hit 95th pctile latency < 220ms for summary flows during peeks, we'll be in great shape. We'll share a small set of test prompts by EOD.

Ravi SE: Great — once prompts arrive I'll run stress tests and share a perf + cost report. Tagging this as high expansion signal and renewal-risk mitigation.
